doit.title: doit.id payments
doit.subtitle: QRIS, Virtual Account and bank transfer through doit.id

cards.balance_hint: Net of all successful payments − refunds − withdrawals, all time. Not your real doit.id balance: check the portal before withdrawing.

chart.title: Daily successful payments
chart.empty: No successful payments in this range

table.search: Search reference, order or payment id

excluded_reasons.unmarked: Not created by this store (another app on the same doit.id key, or a portal link)
excluded_reasons.other_store: Created by another Medusa store on the same doit.id key
excluded_reasons.environment: Other mode (test/live) than the API key in use
excluded_reasons.legacy_unknown: Old plugin version, and its Medusa payment session no longer exists

withdrawals.title: Withdrawals
withdrawals.description: Money taken out of your doit.id balance. Enter payouts by hand or import the settlement CSV from the doit.id portal.
withdrawals.fee_hint: doit.id charges Rp10.000 per payout transfer. Leave 0 if the amount above already includes it.
withdrawals.csv_help: Columns are recognised by name: date/tanggal, amount/nominal/jumlah/net, optional fee/biaya, id/reference, status. Rows imported before are skipped.
withdrawals.csv_summary: {{new}} new rows ({{amount}}), {{dup}} already imported, {{skipped}} skipped, {{errors}} errors

attention.title: Needs action
attention.description: Cases a person has to decide. Nothing is refunded automatically.

codes.late_payment_canceled: Paid after the order was canceled
codes.paid_without_session: Paid, but the checkout session is gone

settings.title: doit.id settings
settings.description: Credentials are stored encrypted. Secrets are never shown again after saving.
settings.api_key_hint: pb_test_… for sandbox, pb_live_… for live. Leave empty to keep the current key.
settings.webhook_secret_hint: From the doit.id portal → Developer. Leave empty to keep the current secret.
settings.mode_hint: Detected from the API key prefix.
settings.transfer_warning: Bank transfer cannot be tested on the sandbox yet and needs a live key with a Mutasi Rekening subscription.
settings.va_bank_hint: Required for Virtual Account and bank transfer.
settings.timezone_hint: Where a day starts and ends in the dashboard (IANA name).
settings.test_mismatch: The key prefix and the environment reported by doit.id do not match.
settings.webhook_url_hint: Paste this in the doit.id portal → Developer → Webhook URL.

encryption_status.ok: OK — stored secrets can be read
encryption_status.unused: Not needed yet (no secrets stored in the Admin)
encryption_status.mismatch: DOIT_ENCRYPTION_KEY does not match the stored secrets

settings.reconciliation_hint: Only payments created by this store are reconciled. Payments of other apps or stores on the same doit.id key, of the other mode (test/live) or from before the date below are ignored and never listed under Needs action.
settings.store_marker_hint: Sent as metadata.medusa_store_id with every payment this store creates.
settings.reference_prefix_hint: Optional, shown before the session id in the doit.id portal's reference, e.g. HK-payses_…
settings.ignore_before_hint: Older doit.id payments are not reconciled.
settings.ignore_before_chosen: From 00:00 on this date ({{tz}}). Clear it to use the default.
settings.ignore_before_default: Default: {{date}}, when the API key was first saved here.
settings.ignore_before_none: No date: all payments with this store's marker are reconciled.
